lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Single ~81.5 deg L fold between large flange (patch 1/2) and windowed narrow flange (patch 3/4). Perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% put the line exactly on the outer-skin apex (inner skin ~2.0 mm inward along bisector = sheet thickness). Sampled line-to-cloud distance median 0.21 mm, max 0.35 mm (within 0.5 mm voxel). Line spans t=0..70.2 mm vs part fold extent -0.7..70.8 mm, ~99% coverage, parallel to the fold. Window sits inside the narrow flange and does not reach the fold.
